identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Simplify startup to one config, one binary, and one supervisor

values.task_boundary: Remove cross-binary startup receipt choreography and replace it with direct config validation, loaded-hash readiness, and atomic reload.
deliverables: Kernel direct validation and loaded hash reporting
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Cold start requires only the canonical config and canonical Runtime binary
AC-2: Guardian launches exactly one Runtime child and supervises restart
AC-3: Kernel validates before serving and reports the exact loaded config hash
AC-4: Reload atomically installs a valid candidate or leaves prior config and process intact
AC-5: No prepared receipt handshake remains across CSM, Guardian, and Kernel
AC-6: Existing roster, model-backed Shepherd, all-agent A2A, API auth, signed ACIP, observability, and checkpoints remain intact
AC-7: Focused proof, live Wuji acceptance, review, and publication pass
non_goals: No compatibility copy of the receipt protocol
No unrelated provider or UI work
